title: Read 50 Pages of a Book
info: Any book you like. 50 pages counts. Share your page or a favorite line.

title: Learn One TikTok Dance
info: Pick a dance, learn the whole routine, and film your take.

title: Top-Rated Movie + Creative Review
info: Watch a highly rated IMDb movie, then respond your way: a review video, a reflection essay, or any creative form.

title: Make a Video Edit or Vlog
info: Edit a short video or vlog about anything: a day, a trip, a mood.

title: Vietnam Travel Post
info: Make a travel post about Vietnam: a real trip or a dream itinerary.

title: Learn One Full Song
info: Learn a whole song, and try to memorize the lyrics too.

title: Cook or Bake Something New
info: Make a meal or a dessert from a brand-new recipe.

title: Listen, Then Draw or Write
info: Pick an album, listen to it, and draw or write while it plays.

title: Memorize a Classic Poem
info: Choose a classic poem and learn it by heart.

title: Make Something for Your Favorite Season
info: Create anything inspired by your favorite season: art, writing, photos, you decide.

title: Create a Mini Collage
info: Use scraps or digital cutouts to make a small collage.

title: Free Online Certificate
info: Finish a free online course (Google, Meta, etc.) and earn the certificate.

title: Make an Accessory
info: Make a phone charm, bag charm, bracelet or any accessory yourself.

title: Design an Event Poster
info: Create a poster for an event. It can be a fictional one.

title: Write a Romance Plot
info: Write your own romance drama or movie plot.

title: Fashion Brand Portfolio
info: Create a portfolio for your own fashion brand.

title: Visit 4 New Places + Plog
info: Go to 4 places you have never been to and make a plog (photo log) of it.

title: Make Your Digital Avatar
info: Create a digital version of yourself, or an alter ego. AI tools are okay!

title: Watch a Film from a New Country
info: Watch a movie from a country whose films you have never watched.
